description.text: MIP-23 moves PSR downtime coverage to 100% validator-funded. Validators cover the full charge across the 0%-99% uptime band; the DAO reserve stops funding any part of it. The 1% grace period is unchanged; Marinade Select is out of scope. Bond floors already reserve one full epoch of staker rewards, which is the maximum a 100% charge can claim, so no bond change is needed and stakers are unaffected either way. Marinade Labs announces the effective epoch at least 3 epochs ahead.
